top_signal.title: Looking for a reliable VOIP
top_signal.summary: Looking for a reliable VoIP provider with business texting   I own a small law firm and desperately need a reliable VoIP provider that actually helps with SMS/A2P 10DLC registration.  I’ve had terrible experiences with Phone.com and RingCentral. My texting campaign was rejected about 18 times, and their support was useless. I don’t have the time to keep going back and forth trying to get approved.  Texting clients is essential for my practice. I need a provider that will actually walk me through registration, help fix any issues, and get it approved.  Anyone have recommendations based on actual experience? I’m beyond frustrated at this point.       submitted by     /u/Goody2shoes4u       [link]       [comments]
